purpose: Download, align, audit, and deterministically select 24 PPARG receptor candidates for cognate redocking without reading activity labels beyond frozen source allocation or any docking outcome.

reference.pocket_derivation: wild-type chain-A standard amino-acid residues with a heavy atom within 6.0 A of any 208 heavy atom
reference.anchor_derivation: the reference-pocket subset with a heavy atom within 4.0 A of any 208 heavy atom

coordinate_gate.chain_identifier: author chain from the frozen metadata candidate CSV
coordinate_gate.alternate_location_rule: highest occupancy, then blank, A, and lexical tie-break
coordinate_gate.alignment: proper-rotation Kabsch alignment using same-number, same-residue-name protein C-alpha atoms
coordinate_gate.global_incomplete_residue_policy: record only during structural selection; apply one frozen deterministic completion protocol before receptor preparation and redocking

features: pairwise ligand-pocket side-chain heavy-atom centroid distances
structural_selection.standardization: feature-wise z score over all coordinate-eligible structures, then division by the square root of retained feature count
structural_selection.selection_rule: deterministic max-min structural distance seeded by PPARG_2GTK_reference; ties resolved by lexical conformer ID
structural_selection.failure_action: stop before receptor preparation, redocking, production docking, QUBO fitting, validation sampling, or validation access if fewer than 24 structures pass

interpretation_boundary: Passing this gate establishes only a structurally diverse, label-independent PPARG receptor candidate pool. Receptor preparation and three-seed cognate redocking remain mandatory before any PPARG benchmark docking; no enrichment, QUBO, quantum-application, or quantum-advantage conclusion follows.
